pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/CatalogTree.tsx:243 The catalog tree asks for weight 700 in `t.fontMono`. Under the default Blueprint theme (theme.ts:30) that resolves to IBM Plex Mono, which is declared only at 400/500/600, so the browser falls back to the 600 face (or a synthesized bold) without a warning. The technique names exactly this failure: a requested weight with no face behind it.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/CatalogTree.tsx:243 className={t.fontMono} at line 241 maps to ibmPlexMono.className (theme.ts:30), declared 400/500/600 only, so 700 has no face. PipelineRail.tsx:387/404 also ask for 700 on var(--lab-font-mono).

src/components/layout-lab/Baseline/index.tsx:242 The loaded Baseline is three columns (tree 260 + pipeline 320 + canvas). Its first-paint placeholder (NewHome.tsx:71) restates a two-column '260px 1fr' literal, so the canvas placeholder sits 320px off where the canvas lands. The placeholder is not derived from the same source as the loaded layout.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout/ShellSkeleton.tsx:13 The first-paint shell skeleton restates the rail width as its own literal (the comment says it mirrors COLLAPSED_WIDTH in SidebarL1.tsx, kept un-imported on purpose). It also reserves only the collapsed 56px L1 rail, while SidebarL1 animates between 56 and EXPANDED_WIDTH 180. The placeholder and the loaded rail can disagree, which is the restated-constant failure the technique names.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout/ShellSkeleton.tsx:13 Restated rather than derived from SidebarL1's COLLAPSED_WIDTH (SidebarL1.tsx:11). Plus: ModuleSkeleton is shared by the Suspense fallback and the shell skeleton (ShellSkeleton.tsx:68), so the one-placeholder rule is met for the content slot.
src/components/layout/ModuleRenderer/registry.tsx:13 Module views are split per module with React.lazy, so each module's code loads on demand instead of riding the shell's first load.
